issues.title: AskBar clipped at viewport bottom
issues.description: The input bar and action buttons overflow the bottom of the screen.
issues.evidence: The lower boundary of the AskBar input and action buttons is cut off at the viewport edge.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom safe-area padding to keep the input bar fully in view.
issues.triageNote: Geometry probe shows no actual clipping (askbar bottom = 640 = viewport height, buttons bottom 612, 26px bottom padding intact) — the visual report was a misread of the bar ending flush at the fold; the REAL confirmed defect on this pair was the React controlled-input console error from <TextField.Input value="" /> with no onChange (fired every render), fixed by making the input uncontrolled (defaultValue) plus safe-area-aware bottom padding.

issues.title: Incomplete placeholder text
issues.description: The search input placeholder text cuts off abruptly.
issues.evidence: Placeholder ends with trailing 'או' at the bottom input bar.
issues.suggestion: Ensure full placeholder copy renders without premature truncation.
issues.triageNote: Placeholder copy (page-supplied) measures 341px vs 214px of input width at phone size, so truncation is physically unavoidable; fixed the abrupt mid-word RTL cut by adding text-overflow: ellipsis to the embedded TextField.Input — post-fix re-audit of pair-058 no longer flags AskBar.
